<?php

namespace CloudSDK\Infrastructure;

use Psr\Log\LoggerInterface;
use Psr\Log\LogLevel;

class ShutdownCoordinator
{
    private LoggerInterface $logger;
    private array $handlers = [];
    private bool $shuttingDown = false;
    private string $instanceId;
    private MetricsCollector $metrics;

    public function __construct(LoggerInterface $logger, MetricsCollector $metrics, string $instanceId)
    {
        $this->logger = $logger;
        $this->metrics = $metrics;
        $this->instanceId = $instanceId;
        pcntl_signal(SIGTERM, [$this, 'handleSignal']);
        pcntl_signal(SIGINT, [$this, 'handleSignal']);
    }

    public function registerHandler(string $name, callable $handler, int $priority = 0): void
    {
        $this->handlers[] = [
            'name' => $name,
            'handler' => $handler,
            'priority' => $priority,
            'registered_at' => microtime(true),
        ];
        usort($this->handlers, fn($a, $b) => $b['priority'] <=> $a['priority']);
    }

    public function handleSignal(int $signal): void
    {
        if ($this->shuttingDown) {
            return;
        }
        $this->shuttingDown = true;
        $signalName = $this->resolveSignalName($signal);
        $this->logger->info("Shutdown initiated", [
            'signal' => $signalName,
            'instance_id' => $this->instanceId,
            'handler_count' => count($this->handlers),
        ]);
        $this->executeGracefulShutdown();
    }

    private function executeGracefulShutdown(): void
    {
        $context = new ShutdownContext($this->instanceId);

        foreach ($this->handlers as $entry) {
            $name = $entry['name'];
            try {
                $result = ($entry['handler'])($context);
                $this->logHandlerResult($name, $result, $context);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $this->logHandlerFailure($name, $e, $context);
            }
        }

        $this->metrics->flush();
        $this->logger->info("Shutdown complete", ['instance_id' => $this->instanceId]);
    }

    private function logHandlerResult(string $handlerName, $result, ShutdownContext $context): void
    {
        $message = sprintf(
            "Handler [%s] completed - duration: %.4fs",
            $handlerName,
            $context->elapsed()
        );
        $this->logger->info($message, [
            'handler' => $handlerName,
            'result' => $this->serializeResult($result),
            'instance_id' => $this->instanceId,
        ]);
    }

    private function logHandlerFailure(string $handlerName, \Throwable $e, ShutdownContext $context): void
    {
        $message = sprintf(
            "Handler [%s] failed after %.4fs: %s",
            $handlerName,
            $context->elapsed(),
            $this->sanitizeLogContent($e->getMessage())
        );
        $this->logger->error($message, [
            'handler' => $handlerName,
            'exception_class' => get_class($e),
            'instance_id' => $this->instanceId,
        ]);
    }

    private function serializeResult($result): string
    {
        if (is_null($result)) {
            return 'null';
        }
        if (is_scalar($result)) {
            return $this->sanitizeLogContent((string) $result);
        }
        return json_encode($result, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP);
    }

    private function sanitizeLogContent(string $content): string
    {
        $content = str_replace(["\r\n", "\r", "\n"], ' ', $content);
        $content = preg_replace('/[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F\x7F]/', '', $content);
        return $content;
    }

    private function resolveSignalName(int $signal): string
    {
        $map = [SIGTERM => 'SIGTERM', SIGINT => 'SIGINT', SIGHUP => 'SIGHUP'];
        return $map[$signal] ?? "SIGNAL_{$signal}";
    }
}

class ShutdownContext
{
    private string $instanceId;
    private float $startTime;
    private array $metadata = [];

    public function __construct(string $instanceId)
    {
        $this->instanceId = $instanceId;
        $this->startTime = microtime(true);
    }

    public function elapsed(): float
    {
        return microtime(true) - $this->startTime;
    }

    public function setMeta(string $key, $value): void
    {
        $this->metadata[$key] = $value;
    }

    public function getMeta(string $key, $default = null)
    {
        return $this->metadata[$key] ?? $default;
    }

    public function getInstanceId(): string
    {
        return $this->instanceId;
    }
}

class MetricsCollector
{
    private array $buffer = [];
    private LoggerInterface $logger;

    public function __construct(LoggerInterface $logger)
    {
        $this->logger = $logger;
    }

    public function record(string $metric, float $value, array $tags = []): void
    {
        $this->buffer[] = compact('metric', 'value', 'tags');
    }

    public function flush(): void
    {
        if (empty($this->buffer)) {
            return;
        }
        $summary = $this->buildFlushSummary();
        $this->logger->info($summary, ['metrics_count' => count($this->buffer)]);
        $this->buffer = [];
    }

    private function buildFlushSummary(): string
    {
        return 'Flushed ' . count($this->buffer) . ' metrics';
    }
}

class ServiceRegistry
{
    private ShutdownCoordinator $coordinator;
    private array $services = [];
    private const ALLOWED_NAME_PATTERN = '/^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+$/';

    public function __construct(ShutdownCoordinator $coordinator)
    {
        $this->coordinator = $coordinator;
    }

    public function register(string $serviceName, object $service, array $options = []): void
    {
        if (!preg_match(self::ALLOWED_NAME_PATTERN, $serviceName)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid service name');
        }
        $this->services[$serviceName] = $service;
        $priority = $options['shutdown_priority'] ?? 0;
        $drainLabel = $serviceName;

        $this->coordinator->registerHandler(
            $drainLabel,
            function (ShutdownContext $ctx) use ($service, $serviceName, $drainLabel) {
                if (method_exists($service, 'drain')) {
                    $service->drain();
                }
                $ctx->setMeta('last_drained', $drainLabel);
                return ['service' => $serviceName, 'drained' => true];
            },
            $priority
        );
    }
}
